prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 7 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, Day, bright daylight from large windows.
Image 1: the character sheet of Su Yaqing (27)
Image 2: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 3: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 4: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 6: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 7: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 8: the prop video-calling phone; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Su Yaqing sits in the middle of the cream bouclé sofa among pastel cushions, legs crossed, facing the low glass coffee table on the pale rug. She holds the video-calling phone up at face height. The kitchen doorway is at the back of the room behind the sofa, and it is empty. The large windows are on the side wall, and a floor lamp stands at each end of the sofa. The camera is in front of the sofa, beyond the glass coffee table, and stays on that side.
Panel 1: Wide shot, slow push in from beyond the glass coffee table, eye-level, full-length framing of the sofa. Su Yaqing lounges on the cream sofa with her long legs crossed, smiling at the phone she holds up, mouth closed.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level. Su Yaqing's eyebrows rise and she stops smiling, mouth closed.
Panel 3: Close-up, low angle, quick push in. Su Yaqing leans forward toward the phone, her mouth falling open in surprise.
Panel 4: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Su Yaqing onto the phone screen, eye-level. Su Yaqing's shoulder and curls fill the foreground, and the phone screen shows the video call.
Panel 5: Close-up, handheld, eye-level. Su Yaqing blinks twice, mouth closed, then her lips press against a laugh.
Panel 6: Medium shot, high angle over the glass coffee table. Su Yaqing bursts out laughing and slaps a pastel cushion beside her.
Panel 7: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level. Su Yaqing shakes her head at the phone, still laughing.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
